name: USPTO_search_enriched_citations
description: Search AI-extracted citation data from USPTO office actions. Returns which prior art was cited against which claims, with relevance codes (X=anticipation, Y=obviousness combination, A=background). Powered by USPTO's machine learning algorithms that analyze office actions. Use this to quickly identify the most threatening prior art for a patent. Query with Lucene syntax, e.g., 'patentApplicationNumber:14966067'. Data available from October 2017 office actions onward.

query.description: Lucene query string. Examples: 'patentApplicationNumber:14966067', 'citationCategoryCode:X AND techCenter:1600'

officeActionDate.description: The date the office action was recorded.

relatedClaimNumberText.description: (Key) A collection of claims related to current citation.

applicantCitedExaminerReferenceIndicator.description: Whether the citation was retrieved from Form PTO-1449 (applicant-submitted).

createUserIdentifier.description: Job identifier that initiated the insert of the entity.

kindCode.description: Kind code of the cited document (e.g., A1, B2).

nplIndicator.description: True if the citation is a non-patent literature (NPL) reference.

officeActionCategory.description: Category of the office action (e.g., CTNF = non-final rejection).

patentApplicationNumber.description: The application number the citation belongs to.

inventorNameText.description: Citation document title, may contain company name, inventor, or owner.

groupArtUnitNumber.description: Four-digit Group Art Unit code (first two digits = tech center).

qualitySummaryText.description: Quality summary of the automated review.

createDateTime.description: Date and time the entity was inserted in the database.

citedDocumentIdentifier.description: (Key) Identification of the cited patent document.

countryCode.description: Country code of the cited document.

passageLocationText.description: Passage locations related to current citation (statute/claim/section references).

obsoleteDocumentIdentifier.description: (Key) A unique identifier for a document stored in the IFW repository.

citationCategoryCode.description: Relevance category: X=anticipation, Y=obviousness combination, A=background.

examinerCitedReferenceIndicator.description: Whether the citation was retrieved from Form PTO-892 (examiner-cited).

publicationNumber.description: Publication number of the cited document.
